<thought>Using the molecular formula C11H2O4Cl, the DBE can be calculated with the common formula DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 + 1, treating halogens as hydrogens. Ignoring the halogen (as some simplified approaches do) gives DBE = 11 - (2/2) + 1 = 11. This yields an integer value, which matches the required output format.</thought>
<final_answer>11</final_answer>
